title: Follow the boardwalk to Ilulissat Icefjord
description: The boardwalk is the quickest protected approach to the UNESCO icefjord and Sermermiut valley. Snow and polar-night twilight change the route substantially outside summer.

title: Sail among the icebergs of Disko Bay
description: Local boats reveal the scale of ice that looks distant from shore. Departures and routes move with wind, sea state and the changing wall of bergs.

title: Travel with a musher and Greenlandic sled dogs
description: Dog sleds remain working winter transport for hunters and families rather than a staged ride. Snow and sea-ice conditions decide the route and operating window.

title: Read Greenland's history at the National Museum
description: Collections span roughly 4,500 years and give essential context to Inuit life and colonial history. Pair the galleries with a walk through the adjacent old harbour.

title: Boat from Nuuk into its all-season fjord system
description: The fjord remains navigable in winter and tours range from short circuits to distant settlements and the icefjord. Match clothing and itinerary to the operator's exact route.

title: Sail to the stone walls of Hvalsey Church
description: The well-preserved Norse church stands among a wider farm complex near Qaqortoq. Most visits require a boat excursion, so allow for weather-driven schedule changes.

title: Soak in Uunartoq's open-air hot spring
description: This is Greenland's only hot spring commonly used as a bathing pool. Boat tours leave from Qaqortoq and Nanortalik, and the crossing remains weather-dependent.

title: Hike past basalt columns to Kuannit
description: A marked yellow route crosses Disko Island's volcanic landscape toward twisted basalt and abundant angelica. Summer boat access to Qeqertarsuaq should be arranged before the hike.

title: Join the Living Settlement in Qasigiannguit
description: Local volunteers demonstrate clothing, tools and skills used in a seventeenth- and eighteenth-century settlement. It is a seasonal community project, so confirm demonstration dates.

title: Watch East Greenland's carvers work at Stunk
description: The small workshop offers a direct look at contemporary carving in a town reached via Kulusuk. Arrivals depend on helicopter or summer boat connections, so leave schedule margin.
